# Glossary

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-viewmodel/glossary/glossary.toml. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

What an EPLAN or QElectroTech user calls a thing, and what to look for in EW. Every EPLAN and QET term below is also an alias in the command palette (Ctrl+K): typing "folio report" finds Interruption point. The table is generated from the glossary file [`crates/ew-viewmodel/glossary/glossary.toml`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/crates/ew-viewmodel/glossary/glossary.toml), the one source of the palette's aliases and of this page. The behaviour behind each term is explained in the design glossary's translation table ([glossary §4](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/glossary.md#4-translation-table-eplan-qelectrotech-elektrawatt)).

| EW term | Dutch | EPLAN | QElectroTech | Definition | Palette actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Function | Functie | Function | Element, Element instance | One placed instance of a function definition: a coil, a contact, a terminal; it belongs to a device. | `tool.place` |
| Device | Apparaat | Device, Device tag, DT, BMK | Element label | The product with a tag (-102F1) that groups its functions; the tag is derived from the structure and the counter. | `tool.place_part`, `devices.renumber` |
| Part | Artikel | Part, Article | Manufacturer reference | A manufacturer's article from a library; a project holds a copy of each part it uses, attached to devices. | `tool.place_part`, `parts.import` |
| Wire marker | Adermarkering | CDP, Connection definition point | Conductor text | A marker on a connection that shows or overrides its number, colour and cross-section. | `tool.marker` |
| Interruption point | Onderbrekingspunt | Interruption point | Folio report | Where a potential leaves one page and continues on another; pairs are found by name, star or chain. | `tool.ip` |
| Basic project | Basisproject | Basic project | Template project | The project a new project starts from: frames, settings and libraries; the company standard wizard writes one. | `file.new`, `tools.company_standard` |
| Frame and title block | Kader en titelblok | Form, Plot frame | Title-block template | The form a page is drawn in; every title-block field binds to a project property, never to literal text. | `tools.company_standard` |
| Messages | Meldingen | Message management |  | The findings of the checks, each with its rule ID, cause and remedy; a finding can be waived with a reason. | `messages.show` |
| Main and auxiliary function | Hoofd- en hulpfunctie | Main function, Auxiliary function | Master/slave, Master, Slave | A device's main function (a coil) and its auxiliary functions (its contacts), linked by data, not by text. | `tool.place`, `place.join` |
| Connection | Verbinding | Connection | Conductor | An explicit wire between two connection points; its potential, number and wire colour are derived. | `tool.wire` |
| Terminal strip | Klemmenstrook | Terminal strip | Terminal strip | A device whose functions are terminals in a fixed order, with levels, bridges and accessories. | `strip.new` |
| Structure node | Structuurknooppunt | Structure identifier, Identifier block, Higher-level function, Mounting location | Plant, Location | A node of the function (=) or location (+) aspect; pages and devices are assigned to nodes. | `structure.new` |
| Black box | Black box | Black box | Rectangle | A representation drawn as a rectangle with device connection points, for a device without a symbol. | `tool.black_box` |
| Structure box | Structuurkader | Structure box | Dotted shape | A dashed frame on a page that assigns what it encloses to a structure node. | `tool.structure_box` |
| Report block | Rapportblok | Report, Update reports, Embedded report | Summary, Nomenclature, Folio list | A generated table (parts list, terminal diagram, table of contents); reports are always current, there is no update step. | — |
| Potential | Potentiaal | Potential, Potential definition point |  | The electrical net a connection belongs to (24VDC-1, PE); it is derived, and its wire colour follows from it. | — |
| Cross-reference | Kruisverwijzing | Cross-reference, Contact image | Cross-reference | The derived reference between a device's main and auxiliary functions on their pages, with the contact image. | — |
